title: Graph Sensitivity of Cartesian Products with Matched Bridges
summary: For a graph $G$, let $f_t(G)$ denote the minimum of the maximum degree of an induced subgraph with $α(G)+t$ vertices, where $α(G)$ is the independence number, and write $f(G)=f_1(G)$. Huang's theorem gives $f(Q_k)\ge\lceil\sqrt{k}\rceil$ for the $k$-dimensional hypercube $Q_k$. We extend this lower bound to Cartesian products of $k$ bipartite graphs with perfect matchings and prove that equality holds when the factors are connected and each has a matched bridge. In particular, we prove that $f(T_1\Box\cdots\Box T_k)=\lceil\sqrt{k}\rceil$ whenever each $T_i$ is a tree with a perfect matching.…
